scenes.text: Imagine losing your entire life savings and your professional reputation over a single missing word when, back in 1631, royal London printers were tasked with publishing a prestigious new run of the King James Bible.
Everything seemed absolutely flawless until the copies were distributed to the public, and readers noticed a horrifying, scandalous mistake hidden right inside the sacred Ten Commandments.
Instead of printing "Thou shalt not commit adultery," the printers accidentally omitted the crucial word "not," literally commanding the entire British kingdom to go out and sin.

This massive blunder infuriated the King, who instantly bankrupted the printers with heavy fines and destroyed the books, so would you ever own one of the fifteen surviving "Wicked Bibles" today, or do you think they are cursed? Let us know in the comments and follow for more.
